title: 2004 AMC 10B Problem 8
statement: Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is \(8\) miles southwest of downtown St. Paul and \(10\) miles southeast of downtown Minneapolis. Which of the following is closest to the number of miles between downtown St. Paul and downtown Minneapolis?

solutions.text:
The two given directions are perpendicular, so the airport sits at the right angle of a right triangle with legs \(8\) and \(10.\)

The distance between the downtowns is \(\sqrt{8^2 + 10^2} = \sqrt{164} \approx 12.8,\) which is closest to \(13.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Southwest and southeast are perpendicular directions
The distance is \(\sqrt{8^2 + 10^2}\); estimate the nearest whole number
